topics.name: Dependency Version Compatibility
topics.purpose: Define exact compatibility constraints between package/module/domain/runtime dependencies without selecting versions by newest-wins.

semantics.resolution_rule: Resolution is deterministic from accepted candidates and declared policy.
semantics.newest_rule: Newest version is not automatically selected unless an explicit policy says so.
semantics.breaking_rule: Breaking new identity cannot satisfy old dependency by version similarity alone.

invariants.rule: Package, artifact, module, certification, license and installed-instance identities remain distinct; hashes prove content integrity only within their declared profile and never grant runtime authority.
License or certification entitlement permits declared product/service use only; it never substitutes for IAM identity, AccessCore authorization, runtime validation or dispatcher gating.

hard_gates.condition: different identity accepted because name similar

references.purpose: Breaking identities cannot masquerade as compatible versions.
